items.exampleEn: The price of the watch was suspiciously low.
items.exampleZh: 那支手錶的價格低得可疑。

items.exampleEn: Each exercise in the book is short and purposeful.
items.exampleZh: 這本書裡的每個練習都簡短又有明確目的。

items.exampleEn: Finishing the job in one day is an impossibility.
items.exampleZh: 一天之內完成這份工作是不可能的事。

items.exampleEn: Don't overestimate your strength; ask for help with the heavy box.
items.exampleZh: 別高估自己的力氣，搬那個重箱子要找人幫忙。

items.exampleEn: Can you deduce the answer from these three clues?
items.exampleZh: 你能從這三條線索推斷出答案嗎？

items.exampleEn: His argument is predicated on old information.
items.exampleZh: 他的論點是建立在舊資訊上的。

items.exampleEn: Shouting at the referee was an unwise move.
items.exampleZh: 對裁判大吼是不明智的舉動。

items.exampleEn: Unforeseen circumstances forced the team to cancel today's match.
items.exampleZh: 意料之外的狀況迫使球隊取消了今天的比賽。

items.sentenceEn: For a small child, sitting still for an hour is almost an impossibility.
items.sentenceZh: 對小小孩來說，安靜坐著一個小時幾乎是不可能的事。

items.audioEn: We overestimated how many people would come, so half the chairs were empty.
items.audioZh: 我們高估了會來的人數，所以有一半的椅子是空的。
options: Not as many people came as we planned

items.sentenceEn: The two friends predicated their whole business plan on cheap rent.
items.sentenceZh: 那兩個朋友把整個創業計畫建立在便宜房租的前提上。

items.sentenceEn: It was unwise of me to spend all my money on the first day.
items.sentenceZh: 我第一天就把錢花光，真是不明智。

items.stemEn: The trip cost more than planned because of ____ problems with the car.
items.stemZh: 因為車子出了意料之外的問題，這趟旅行花的錢比計畫多。

items.stemEn: From the muddy shoes by the door, she could ____ that her son had been outside.
items.stemZh: 從門邊那雙沾滿泥的鞋子，她推斷得出兒子出去過。

items.passageEn: Last Monday, the birthday cake in our office fridge disappeared. Our boss walked around looking at everyone suspiciously. One of my colleagues loves mystery stories, so she tried to deduce who had taken it. She found chocolate on the door handle of the meeting room and walked toward it in a purposeful way. Inside, she found the cake, almost whole. It turned out that the cleaning team had moved it because of an unforeseen problem with our lousy old fridge: it had stopped working overnight. Everyone laughed, and the boss admitted that it had been unwise to blame people so quickly.
items.passageZh: 上週一，辦公室冰箱裡的生日蛋糕不見了。老闆走來走去，用懷疑的眼光看著每個人。我有一位同事很愛看推理小說，所以她試著推理是誰拿走了蛋糕。她在會議室的門把上發現巧克力，於是堅定地朝會議室走去。結果她在裡面找到了蛋糕，幾乎完好無缺。原來是我們那台很爛的舊冰箱出了意料之外的問題：它半夜停止運轉了，所以清潔人員把蛋糕移走。大家都笑了，老闆也承認那麼快就怪罪別人是不明智的。

questions.questionZh: 同事是怎麼找到蛋糕的？
options: 調出走廊的監視器畫面
順著門把上的巧克力找到會議室

questions.questionZh: 蛋糕為什麼不在冰箱裡？
options: 老闆想給大家驚喜，把它藏了起來
冰箱壞了，清潔人員把它移走

items.promptZh: 那隻貓懷疑地聞了聞新的食物。
referenceEn: The cat smelled the new food suspiciously.
The cat suspiciously smelled its new food.
rubricZh: suspiciously 的用法，例如 smelled the food suspiciously、suspiciously smelled 等
時態合理（例如 smelled 等）

items.promptZh: 我高估了自己的速度，結果到半夜還在寫作業。
referenceEn: I overestimated my own speed, so I was still doing homework at midnight.
Because I overestimated my speed, I was still doing my homework at midnight.
rubricZh: overestimate 的用法；時態配合句意（例如 overestimated、have overestimated 等）
「到半夜還在寫作業」可寫，例如 was still doing homework at midnight、am still doing… 等
